Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views let you capture the exact combination of filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you can return to the perspective that matters most without rebuilding it each time. Whether you track sprint progress, monitor overdue tasks, or organize work by owner, you can now store that setup and jump back to it in one click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving plenty of room for personal, project-specific, and cross-team perspectives. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and it's ready to use right now. We built this based on feedback from teams who wanted faster access to the views they check most often, and we hope it saves you time every day.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
